textes.L'exercice est l'année civile (1er janvi: The fiscal year is the calendar year (1 January to 31 December). Closing means finalising the year's accounts: expenses and income are cleared, the result is recorded, balance sheet balances are carried to the next year and the period is locked. Do it with your accountant, after closing the cash register, reconciling the bank and counting the stock.

textes.Méthode : la dépense est sortie du résul: Method: the expense leaves the result on the day it is booked (account 476), then at each month end the month's share goes back in, pro rata by days (exact rounding). On the balance sheet, the rest is an asset (prepaid expense) or a liability (deferred income). Have it validated by your accountant.
textes.Méthode : linéaire, au mois entier à par: Method: straight-line, by whole month from the in-service month, charge booked at month end. Lives per category are indicative. No distinction between book and tax depreciation. To be validated with your accountant.
textes.Repère calculé sur les retards passés (n: Guide computed from past delays (score out of 100). “Risky”: require a deposit or reduce the credit limit. Customers without enough history are not scored.
textes.Situation cumulée depuis l'ouverture des: Cumulative position since the books were opened: closed fiscal years are carried into the equity accounts (result pending allocation or retained earnings). A cash or bank account on the liabilities side signals a negative balance or missing opening balances.
Cumulative position since the books were opened. A cash or bank balance on the liabilities side signals an overdraft or missing opening balances.
textes.Repère indicatif seulement : 50 % du res: Indicative guide only: 50% of the balance due from 90 days late, 100% from 180 days. Decide yourself, with your accountant.

textes.Un devis ne change ni le stock ni la com: A quote changes neither stock nor accounting until it is converted into a sale.
textes.Un bien durable (matériel, véhicule, loc: A durable asset (equipment, vehicle, premises…) is not a monthly expense: it is recorded as an asset then depreciated over its useful life. The proposed lives are indicative: have them validated.
textes.Une dépense payée d'avance (assurance, l: An expense paid in advance (insurance, a quarter's rent) weighs on the result only month by month, pro rata by days. The period starts on the 1st of the expense month at the earliest and ends after that month.
textes.Dans votre application d'authentificatio: In your authenticator app, add an account using “manual entry” with this key (type: time-based):
textes.Comptez chaque produit en rayon et saisi: Count each product on the shelf and enter the quantity. Leave empty what you have not counted. Only the differences are recorded, and every correction is logged.
textes.De l'argent qui change de compte : ce n': Money moving from one account to another: it is neither an expense nor a sale. It will have to be matched on both sides with the statements. For cash, use a cash movement (deposit or withdrawal).
textes.Déplace une quantité d'un dépôt à l'autr: Moves a quantity from one warehouse to another; total stock does not change.
textes.Indiquez ce qui est réellement remis auj: Enter what is actually handed over today. Stock does not move (already out at the sale).
textes.À la vente, le stock sort du lot qui pér: At the sale, stock leaves from the batch that expires first, never from an expired batch. Enter the batch number and the expiry date when you record a purchase.
textes.Chaque achat entre dans un dépôt et chaq: Each purchase enters a warehouse and each sale leaves one; total stock is the sum. The main warehouse always exists.
textes.Un devis ne change ni le stock ni la com: A quote changes neither stock nor accounting
textes.Comptez chaque produit en rayon et saisi: Count each product on the shelf and enter the quantity. Leave empty what you have not counted. Only the differences are recorded, and every correction is logged. One warehouse is counted at a time.
textes.TVA de ce produit en % (vide : taux de l: VAT of this product in % (empty: company rate; 0: exempt). The rate is frozen on each sale.
textes.Un modèle prépare la dépense de chaque m: A template prepares each month's expense; you confirm the generation yourself.
textes.Retour client remis en stock: Customer return put back in stock
textes.Première installation : créez le compte: First installation: create the owner account. They can then create the team's accounts and view the log of everything that is done.
textes.Vérifiez la connexion, puis rechargez la: Check the connection, then reload the page.
textes.Le mot de passe provisoire donné par le: The temporary password given by the owner must be replaced before continuing.
textes.Les sauvegardes sont chiffrées avec la m: Backups are encrypted with the same key: without it, they are unreadable.
textes.⚠ Base NON chiffrée : bibliothèque de ch: ⚠ Database NOT encrypted: encryption library missing.
textes.Anciennes copies en clair à supprimer vo: Old plain-text copies to delete yourself, after checking: folder clair_a_supprimer.
textes.Dégressif (plus forte les premières anné: Declining balance (higher in the first years)
textes.Coefficient dégressif (indicatif : 1,25: Declining-balance coefficient (indicative: 1.25 for 3-4 years, 1.75 for 5-6 years, 2.25 beyond) — to be validated
textes.Méthodes : linéaire, ou dégressif au cho: Methods: straight-line, or declining balance if you choose (from 3 years), by whole month from the in-service month, charge booked at month end. Lives per category and declining coefficients are indicative. No distinction between book and tax depreciation. To be validated with your accountant.
textes.Une panne ou un vol de l'ordinateur empo: A failure or theft of the computer would also take away the backups stored on it. Enter a folder on a USB stick, an external drive or a synchronised folder: every backup will be copied there and checked, and the last 30 are kept.
textes.⚠ Aucune copie hors de l'ordinateur : vo: ⚠ No copy outside the computer: all your backups are in the same place as your data.
textes.Copie hors de l'ordinateur activée : en: Copy outside the computer enabled: waiting for the next backup.
textes.Copie hors de l'ordinateur activée et vé: Copy outside the computer enabled and verified.
Copy outside the computer turned off.
textes.⚠ Débits et crédits différents : signale: ⚠ Debits and credits differ: report it.
textes.Marchandise rendue par le client (elle r: Goods returned by the customer (they go back into stock)
textes.Laissez 0 pour un avoir sans retour de m: Leave 0 for a credit note without returned goods (price error, goodwill gesture).
textes.Activer les rappels sur cet appareil: Turn on reminders on this device
textes.Désactiver les rappels sur cet appareil: Turn off reminders on this device
textes.Inclure les noms des clients et des prod: Include customer and product names in the message
textes.Envoyer un message même quand il n'y a r: Send a message even when there is nothing to report
Reminders turned on for this device.
Reminders turned off on this device.
textes.Une fois par jour, au premier contrôle,: Once a day, at the first check, this device shows the points to look at (late payments, stock, deliveries…). It only works while the application is open (page or installed app): when closed, it cannot show anything. To be warned with the application closed, use the e-mail reminder.
textes.Chaque matin, à l'heure choisie, un résu: Every morning, at the chosen time, a summary of the points to look at is sent to your addresses (and only if there is something to report). Nothing is sent until you have filled in and turned on this page. For Gmail or Outlook, use an “app password”, never your real password. E-mail is not an encrypted channel: by default the message only contains numbers and amounts, no customer or product names.
textes.Les ventes d'articles libres (sans produ: Sales of free-text items (not from the catalogue) are grouped separately; a product without a category goes under “Sans catégorie”.
textes.L'objectif de la période = l'objectif me: Target for the period = monthly target × number of months in the period (a started month counts as a whole month). In red: less than half of the target achieved.
textes.Objectif MENSUEL en montant TTC (GNF) po: MONTHLY target in amount incl. tax (GNF) for each salesperson. Leave empty for no target. Every change is recorded in the log.
textes.Aucun commercial actif : créez d'abord u: No active salesperson: first create a “Sales” account in Team.
textes.Sceaux : signatures du journal hors du s: Seals: journal signatures made off the server
textes.Aucune clé enregistrée : les sceaux ne s: No key registered: seals are not in place yet.
textes.Collez ici le sceau signé (résultat de «: Paste the signed seal here (result of “signer”)
textes.Texte illisible : collez le résultat de: Unreadable text: paste the result of “signer” as is.
textes.Journal scellé (signature hors serveur): Journal sealed (signature made off the server)
textes.Le client a promis de payer le (facultat: The customer promised to pay on (optional)
textes.Vérifiez que chaque colonne correspond b: Check that each column is right. If your bank names its columns differently, choose them here: the choice is remembered for future statements in the same format.
textes.Mise en service : êtes-vous prêt pour la: Going live: are you ready to enter real data?
textes.Bulletin simplifié : les taux et retenue: Simplified payslip: rates and deductions are those entered by the company.
textes.Simple relevé : l'application ne calcule: Record only: the application does not calculate leave entitlements or balances, and an absence does not change the payslip. Correct the number of days if non-working days should not be counted.

motifs.re: ^Dégressif \(coefficient (.+)\) : environ (.+) la première année \((.+) par mois\), puis des dotations qui baissent ; la méthode bascule d'elle-même en linéaire quand c'est plus avantageux, et la dernière année solde le bien\.$
